meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (J560/02, Thursday 15 May 2025). Derived metadata only — question numbers, marks and skill tags. No exam question text transcribed.
meta.note: THIS is OCR's non-calculator Foundation paper, not paper 1 — the opposite of AQA and Edexcel. 100 marks, read from the [N] part markers in the QP margin.

coding_notes: q4a(i) (name two 2D shapes from their pictures) is UNTAGGED: it is the known 'properties of 2D shapes' gap — data/skills.ts has properties_of_3d_solids with no 2D counterpart. Topic stated so its 2 marks still land under Shape and Space.
q4a(ii) tagged symmetry — order of rotational symmetry is exactly that node's own example, and it costs no prerequisites.
q11 tagged time_calculations first so the item files under Number: the demand is converting two mixed minute-and-second durations to a common unit before forming the fraction.

q19a (how many terms two arithmetic sequences share) tagged sequences + lowest_common_multiple — the mark scheme's efficient route is the LCM of the two common differences, and it credits listing equally.
q22 (complete a congruence proof for two triangles in a rectangle) tagged congruence_and_similarity; the missing piece is naming the congruence condition, which that node covers.
q26 (sector area to circle area in a given ratio, answer non-calculator) tagged sector_calculations + area_of_a_circle.

q14b tagged compound_units FIRST: the distance-per-litre rate is the primary demand, and putting it first files the 5 marks under Ratio and Proportion where the specification puts rates. With fractions_of_amounts leading it landed under Number, which on this paper is already inflated to 40% of the marks by data/skills.ts filing percentages, unit conversion and indices under Number — the classification oddity docs/coding-a-paper.md already records.
q4ai RETAGGED to properties_of_2d_shapes (was untagged (name two 2D shapes)) when that skill was added to data/skills.ts. The audit had flagged this row as a taxonomy gap; it is no longer one.

q4b RETAGGED to properties_of_2d_shapes (was untagged (notation showing a triangle is isosceles)) when that skill was added to data/skills.ts. The audit had flagged this row as a taxonomy gap; it is no longer one.
